mainEntity.name: Do you inspect septic systems on farms and large rural lots?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Expect the locating step to take longer on a large lot with no layout drawing, and tell me if equipment has been driven over the drain field area; that's one of the things the inspection looks at.

mainEntity.name: How do I get the Alexander County septic permit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call or visit Alexander County Environmental Health at 151 W Main Ave., Taylorsville, 828-632-1000. There's no online search. Ask for the permit, any layout drawing and the soil evaluation.

mainEntity.name: Do you serve Bethlehem, Stony Point and Hiddenite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. All of Alexander County is in my service area, including the Bethlehem community on Lake Hickory.
